_comment: Anthropic forced tool-use input_schema for the phase validation step. The model is forced via tool_choice {type:'tool', name:'report_phase_validation'}; the returned tool_use block's 'input' binds to PhaseValidationResult. Non-streaming call.
name: report_phase_validation
description: Report a plain-language summary of the spec-kit phase artifacts and any flagged gaps, risks, or omissions a reviewer should see before approving a tracking work item.

summary.description: One-paragraph plain-language summary of what this phase's artifacts contain.

gaps.description: Flagged gaps, risks, or omissions. Empty array if none were found.

label.description: Short label for the gap (a few words).

description.description: What is missing or risky, and why it matters for the next phase.
